newsitem.title: EU: EC WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, MARCH 24-SUNDAY, MARCH 30.
newsitem.headline: EC WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, MARCH 24-SUNDAY, MARCH 30.

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS

BRUSSELS - EU foreign ministers meet (Monday); discussions focus on Albania, Turkey, South Africa and Burma; ministers hold association council with Romania and structured dialogue with Central and Eastern European Countries.
BRUSSELS - Polish President Aleksander Kwasniewski meets NATO Secretary General Javier Solana (Monday).

ROME - EU foreign ministers hold special meeting to commemorate the 40th anniversary of the 1957 Treaty of Rome (Tuesday); exchange of views with EP President Jose Maria Gil-Robles and MEPs Elisabeth Guigou and Elmar Brok on the state of the inter-governmental conference; Gil-Robles, Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo and European Commission President Santer hold joint news conference following the ceremony.
ROME - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (Tuesday).
BRUSSELS - EU Monetary Committee meets (Tuesday); preparation for April 5 informal ECOFIN Council, stability pact, legal framework for the euro and ERM 2.
Friday - EU institutions closed for Easter holidays to March 31 inclusive.
Sunday - European time changes from GMT+1 to GMT+2 except for Britain, Ireland and Portugal, which change from GMT+0 to GMT+1.
Please note the European Court of Justice is on judicial Easter holiday from Marh 24 to April 4.
MONDAY, MARCH 24
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - General Affairs Council (0930/0830 GMT).
Agenda includes:
- Trade questions, including:
- Conclusion of an Information Technology Agreement;
- Community preferential accords;
- Follow-up to Singapore WTO conference on less advanced countries.
- Relations with South Africa.
- State of negotiations with Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon.
- Relations with Turkey.
- Relations with Albania.
- Great Lakes Regions/Zaire.
- Situation in former Yugoslavia.
- Peace process in the Middle East.
- (1045/0945 GMT) Association Council with Romania.
- (1200/1100 GMT) Structured dialogue with Central and Eastern European Countries.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Polish President Aleksander Kwasniewski meets NATO Secretary General Javier Solana (0800/0700 GMT).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Finnish Defence Minister Anneli Taina meets WEU Secretary General Jose Cutileiro (1610/1510 GMT).

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime seminar on "Future perspective for the European social fund" (1315/1215 GMT). Speaker is European Commissioner Flynn. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.

BRUSSELS - British Chamber of Commerce in Belgium holds debate on "EU competition policy - Third party rights - Use or abuse?" (1730/1630 GMT). Venue: Meridien Hotel. Contact: British Chamber of Commerce in Belgium (322) 540 9030.
NEW YORK (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Bonino meets United Nations and Unicef officials.
TUESDAY, MARCH 25
ROME (EXPANDED ITEM) - EU foreign ministers hold special meeting to commemorate the 40th anniversary of the 1957 Treaty of Rome.
Agenda includes:
- (0915/0815 GMT) The state of the inter-governmental conference (IGC); exchange of views with EP President Jose Maria Gil-Robles and MEPs Elisabeth Guigou and Elmar Brok.
- (1240/1140 GMT) Italian inter-governmental conference representative Silvio Fagiolo holds news conference on the outcome of the meeting.
- (1300/1200 GMT) Prime Minister Romano Prodi and European Commission President Santer hold joint news conference on the outcome of the General Affairs Council meeting.
- (1345/1245 GMT) Lunch hosted by Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro.
- (1600/1500 GMT) Official commemoration ceremony of the 40th anniversary of the 1957 Treaty of Rome.
- (1700/1600 GMT) EP President Jose Maria Gil-Robles, Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo and European Commission President Santer hold joint news conference following the ceremony.
- (1730/1630 GMT) National parliament presidents meet.
- (2000/1900 GMT) Rome mayor hosts reception.
ROME (NEW ITEM) - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (1730/1630 GMT).
Provisional agenda includes:
- Formal decision to rule French textile aid illegal.
- Commissioner de Deus Pinheiro communication on support for structural adjustments and reduction of ACP countries' debt.
- (possibly) Commissioner de Deus Pinheiro communication on 1995 transfers in favour of Camaroon traditional banana suppliers.
- (possibly) European Commission President Santer communication on a Council regulation on a financial contribution to the international fund for Iceland.
- Commissioners Flynn and Liikanen communication on budgetary guidelines in favour of the handicaped.
BRUSSELS - EU Monetary Committee meets (1000/0900 GMT). Preparation for April 5 informal ECOFIN Council, stability pact, legal framework for the euro and ERM 2.
LUXEMBOURG - European Commission hosts conference on "Mobility and occupational pension schemes in Europe" (0900/0800 GMT). Venue: Jean Monnet building, room M4. Contact: Uniglobe (322) 267 4183.
WASHINGTON (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Bonino meets food safety officials (and Wednesday).
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 26
No events scheduled.
THURSDAY, MARCH 27
No events scheduled.
FRIDAY, MARCH 28
- EU institutions closed for Easter holidays to March 31 inclusive.
SATURDAY, MARCH 29
No events scheduled.
SUNDAY, MARCH 30
- European time changes from GMT+1 to GMT+2 except for Britain, Ireland and Portugal, which change from GMT+0 to GMT+1.
